allKural.translation: Without pity he would depart! You sigh and seek his favour, poor heart!
allKural.couplet: Thou art befooled, my heart, thou followest him who flees from thee;And still thou yearning criest: 'He will nor pity show nor love to me.'

allKural.explanation: You are a fool, O my soul! to go after my departed one, while you mourn that he is not kind enough to favour you
